app.title: Mini.nvim Is Now on Tangled
app.description: A collection of modular Neovim plugins that provide lightweight alternatives to heavier plugins.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `make install`
Create a minimal Neovim config that loads mini.nvim modules
Run a benchmark of file opening and LSP start time
Verify that each module provides its intended functionality (e.g., `mini.move`, `mini.align`)
